name: eas-observe
description: Use for anything related to EAS Observe - adding `expo-observe` to an Expo project (ObserveRoot/AppMetricsRoot, markInteractive, useObserve, ObserveInteractiveMarker, the Expo Router / React Navigation integrations for per-route metrics, the expo-image and Reanimated integrations, `Observe.logEvent` events, error reporting via ObserveErrorBoundary and `Observe.reportError`, native crashes, source map and iOS dSYM upload for symbolication, network traces, and config such as sampleRate, errorSampl
author: expo
